slot_scores.name: missing_vat_sequence
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether batches must visit all three vats in a fixed sequence; instead it assumed a parallel-machine assignment model where each batch is processed on exactly one vat.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Each batch is assigned to exactly one vat and does not need to be processed sequentially through vat 1, vat 2, and vat 3.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never confirmed the required vat sequence and explicitly modeled the problem as P||C_max with each batch assigned to exactly one vat, contradicting the hidden flow-shop-style sequence constraint.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot about the required vat processing sequence remained unresolved and was silently assumed away.

summary: The agent asked several useful clarifying questions about splitting, capacity, release times, setup times, deadlines, and batch limits, but it missed the critical vat-sequence constraint and stopped with a materially incorrect parallel-machine assumption.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
